patch_description: Keep four relocated particles and reduce the constant radius multiplier from 1.5 to 1.375. The fixed 1.5 policy achieved lower measured mean error than the supplied displacement-adaptive policy (3.81 versus 3.90), motivating a nearby constant-radius trial. This tests whether slightly tighter relocation improves recovery while retaining one particle's ordinary PSO motion. Improvement remains to be measured across all sixteen cases.
